ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels accounting for approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels restricted to distal tips, perimeter edges, and scar-tissue boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity central mass. Sparse, high-contrast white mottling localized at the far-left and far-right distal fluke tips. High-frequency circular ring patterns (rosettes) distributed non-uniformly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 60-70 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (saw-tooth pattern) along the entire trailing edge. Peaks and valleys exhibit variable pixel amplitude, becoming increasingly pronounced and jagged toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to sharp, dorsally-oriented distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density detection of roughly circular, high-contrast ring-like pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across both lobes, with higher concentrations observed on the mid-to-outer regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible primarily on the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface; heavy erosion and jagged, non-uniform tissue loss at both the extreme left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific elongated, finger-like protrusion on the far-left trailing edge that deviates from the standard serration frequency.
